long_biography.plain_text:
Keyman entered fertilizer trading through ENKA Marketing and Transammonia before joining three other traders to establish Keytrade near Zurich in 1997. The company developed as an independent intermediary across nitrogen, phosphate and potash supply chains, linking producers with agricultural markets and coordinating logistics worldwide.

In 2007 Keytrade formed an equal joint venture with CF Industries. Eight years later, Keyman and the other principals acquired CF's stake, restoring the business to private control and removing restrictions on its North American nitrogen trade. He remains president while guiding succession to Ahmet Keyman, and also serves on Northwestern University's trustees and backs research in modern Turkish studies and agricultural biotechnology.
